answer: Sybil resistance requires each agent to present a remotely verifiable attestation that its MRENCLAVE matches approved enclave code, alongside a key bound to the attested platform. Cloning a virtual machine cannot forge that hardware-rooted proof or duplicate the platform-bound key; creating another accepted identity requires provisioning another eligible physical enclave, not merely copying software. Verifiers assess measurement changes as a delta, validate the attestation signal, and use a freshness pulse to reject replayed proofs.
